externalSource.title: Homebrew Support Tiers
externalSource.relevantFact: As of September 2026, Homebrew classifies Intel macOS as Tier 3 and states it has stopped building new Intel bottles.

interpretation: The PR's consumer source and focused tests are not implicated by the observed CI failures: the x86 job fails before configuring the consumer, while the arm64 job completes build and required tests before package staging fails. The x86 failure is consistent with Homebrew's announced end of new Intel bottle production. The arm64 failure is in Homebrew receipt selection/staging. These remain real red checks and block a clean hosted package qualification; do not describe the PR as CI-green or merge-ready from these observations.
limits: No PR source code or workflow was modified by this recheck.
The successful builder, CodeQL, and plan-sync jobs do not replace the failed macOS package workflow.
The local 64/64 focused persistence tests and clean consumer build remain macOS-only evidence.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added and no format support claim changed.
next: Repair the macOS package workflow with an explicit supported dependency source for Intel or remove that package qualification lane only after recording a platform support decision. Correct ARM64 package staging against unambiguous bottle metadata, then require a fresh hosted run before claiming the consumer PR passes CI.
